_about: The figure catalogue. 'types': one model each, 'what' is the subject the prompts describe (real equipment of the period; never Vassal art). 'rules': which game piece gets which type, first match wins; type null = the piece keeps its block or counter. Match keys: vol, nat (us de uk it il sy), kind (block or the counter kind), sym (symbol), sub (subtype), name (regex on the piece name).
